text: SK Hynix reported second-quarter revenue of 79.32 trillion won and operating profit of 60.54 trillion won, both substantially above the prior year but below market expectations. Shares closed 9.6% lower after falling as much as 15% intraday. The company reported record first-half revenue, expanded HBM4 shipments, and maintained investment plans.

meta.note: Operating performance and equity valuation occupy different observed structural states within the same event.

text: Brent crude futures rose 7.2% to $90.12 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate futures gained 6.6% to $84.46. U.S. and Iran military activity remained active, while attacks involving oil infrastructure, maritime transit, and regional export routes were reported across the Middle East.

meta.note: Military reports and commodity pricing coexist without establishing directional causation.

text: The Federal Open Market Committee voted 9-3 to maintain the federal funds target range at 3.50%-3.75%. Three regional Federal Reserve presidents dissented in favor of a 25-basis-point increase, while the majority maintained the existing target range. The decision preserved the current policy rate under a recorded split vote.

meta.note: The unchanged policy rate and recorded dissent represent distinct structural states within one decision.

text: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 5.201%, reaching an intraday high of 5.244%, its highest level since 2007. The 10-year yield increased to 4.671%, while the 2-year yield declined to 4.236%. The federal funds target range remained unchanged at 3.50%-3.75%.

meta.note: Yield movements differed across maturities while the policy rate remained unchanged.
